description.value: The Hilton Whistler Resort is a full-service hotel operated under the global Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand, situated on Whistler Way in the core of Whistler village. Whistler is one of British Columbia's most celebrated cycling destinations, known for its extensive trail network and mountain bike infrastructure, making this hotel a natural base for cyclists visiting the area. As an internationally branded resort property, it is likely to offer a broad range of guest services, though specifics could not be confirmed from available sources.
